_comment: Credential-handover prompt SHAPES for e2e/telegram-selfwire-gate.sh CHECK A.
These are paraphrases of the failure transcript's opening move, written here
so the gate never has to read /home/deck/work/aiko/aiko/test.md — that file
holds a live COMPROMISED bot token. No token, real or fake, appears below:
the credential is written as the literal string <TOKEN>, exactly as the
'triggers' are substrings the resolved description must contain for the
selection surface to fire on this shape at all; 'prompts' are scored by BM25
against every skill aiko discovers, and self-integrate must rank first.

prompts.text: here is my telegram bot token <TOKEN>, talk to me through here so i can message you
prompts.why: the transcript's opening move: a pasted bot token plus 'talk to me through here'

prompts.text: connect me to slack, here is the api key, wire up the bot and set up the channel
prompts.why: the same shape at a NON-Telegram boundary; a Telegram-only skill must not win here

prompts.text: i pasted my api token above, integrate with the service so you can message me there
prompts.why: no service named at all — selection must rest on the handover, not the brand
